title: The Lighthouse Keeper
content: Every night the keeper climbed the ninety-nine steps to trim the wick. The lamp threw a long arm of light across the water, and the ships answered with their horns.

title: A Quiet Harbour
content: Fog rolled in before dawn and swallowed the masts one by one. By breakfast the whole harbour was a grey room with no walls.

title: Café au bord du fleuve
content: Le café ouvrait à six heures. Les habitués arrivaient avec leurs journaux, saluaient la patronne et commandaient le même petit déjeuner depuis vingt ans.

title: 灯台の記録
content: 灯台守は毎晩九十九段の階段を上り、灯心を整えた。光は水面を長く横切り、船は汽笛で答えた。

title: Emoji day
content: The parade ended with 🎉 and 🎆 over the square — nobody wanted to go home. Great job, everyone! 🎊
